welcome.title: Welcome to SenseHub
welcome.intro: Your edge computing platform for industrial IoT operations. Manage sensors, relays, controllers, and automate your operations with SenseHub's powerful local processing capabilities.
welcome.featureAutomation: Visual automation builder with triggers and conditions
welcome.featureOffline: Offline-first operation with cloud sync when connected

skip.title: Skip Setup?
skip.warningBody: Skipping setup will create a default administrator account with basic credentials. You will need to:
skip.tempPassword: A temporary password is generated for this account. For security it is not shown here — you will be required to set a new password the first time you sign in.

network.title: Network Configuration
network.subtitle: Configure network settings for your SenseHub device.

timezone.title: Timezone Configuration
timezone.subtitle: Select your timezone for accurate time display and scheduling.
timezone.label: Timezone

admin.title: Create Admin Account
admin.subtitle: Set up your administrator account to manage SenseHub.

cloud.title: Cloud Connection
cloud.subtitle: Connect to SenseHub Cloud for remote monitoring, data backup, and cross-site management.
cloud.optionalNote: This is optional - you can configure it later in Settings.
cloud.offlineBody: Cloud connection is optional. Your system will operate completely independently without it.

complete.title: Setup Complete!
complete.body: Your SenseHub system is ready to use. You're now logged in as the administrator.
complete.nextScan: Scan for equipment on your network
